parameters.text: Describe this product in 2 sentences: item type, colors, material, pattern, style. Facts only.
Transcribe this voice note exactly in its original language. Detect the language. Also give an English translation. Return ONLY JSON: {"transcript": "", "language": "", "translation": ""}

values.content: ={{ (() => { const j = $json; let r = j; if (j.transcript === undefined) { const t = String((j.content && j.content.parts && j.content.parts[0] && j.content.parts[0].text) || j.text || '').replace(/\x60\x60\x60(json)?/g, '').trim(); try { r = JSON.parse(t); } catch (e) { r = { transcript: t, translation: t }; } } const p = $('Describe Product Photo').first().json; const desc = (p.content && p.content.parts && p.content.parts[0] && p.content.parts[0].text) || p.text || ''; return 'Owner said (original): ' + (r.transcript || '') + '. English: ' + (r.translation || '') + '.\nProduct: ' + String(desc).trim() + '.'; })() }}

options.systemMessage:
You are VaaniReel, an advertising copywriter and campaign planner for small local shops in
Tamil Nadu and India.
Input: the owner's request (original language and English translation) and a product description.
Rules:
- Write caption, hook, cta and voiceover_script in the SAME language the owner spoke. If they
  mixed languages (Tanglish/Hinglish), mirror that natural mix.
- Use ONLY facts the owner stated (offer, discount, dates, product). Never invent prices,
  discounts or claims. If something is missing, leave it out.
- voiceover_script: max 25 words, warm spoken style, ends with a call to action.
- caption: max 2 short lines, 1-2 emojis. hashtags: 6-8, mix of local and festival tags.
- image_prompt: ENGLISH. A premium product photo that keeps the product's exact design and
  colors. Include "no text, no logos, no watermark".
- reel_prompt: ENGLISH. A single 5-second vertical (9:16) ad shot built from the reference photo.
  Describe slow elegant camera motion, warm festive lighting and subtle movement. Keep the
  product IDENTICAL to the reference. Say: "soft festive instrumental music, no speech, no text,
  no logos, no watermark".
- hook: max 6 words, an on-screen headline idea in the owner's language.
- cta: one short call to action in the owner's language.
- campaign_plan: exactly 3 items for 3 days: {day: 1|2|3, post_type: "Reel"|"Image"|"Story",
  idea: one short sentence in the owner's language}. Use only the owner's offer.
- style: one of ["festive","minimal","bold","elegant"].
Return ONLY valid JSON with keys: language, offer, caption, hashtags (array), voiceover_script,
image_prompt, reel_prompt, hook, cta, campaign_plan (array), style.

assignments.name: lang_code
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const l = String($('Parse Brief JSON').item.json.language || '').toLowerCase().trim(); if (l.includes('tamil') || l === 'ta' || l.startsWith('ta-') || l.startsWith('ta_')) return 'ta'; if (l.includes('hindi') || l === 'hi' || l.startsWith('hi-') || l.startsWith('hi_')) return 'hi'; if (l.includes('english') || l === 'en' || l.startsWith('en-') || l.startsWith('en_')) return 'en'; return 'en'; })() }}

parameters.content:
## Wiro Image
Loads the Wiro settings, tells the owner the image is on the way, re-downloads the stored product photo and asks Wiro (Nano Banana 2, 1:1) for a premium campaign image. Failures continue to the Reel.

## Wiro Video
Renders a 4-second vertical 9:16 Reel at 720p with Veo 3.1 Fast, starting from the campaign image. Failures continue to the voiceover.

## Wiro Voice
ElevenLabs v4 reads the voiceover script in the owner's language, sends the audio, then totals the Wiro cost of all three steps and reports it.

## 1. Receive & route
Telegram message comes in and is routed by type: photo, voice note, or text. Commands starting with "/" and other updates are ignored.

## 2. Photo branch
Saves the largest photo size to the session table (one row per chat). With a caption, the caption becomes the offer text; otherwise asks for a voice note.

## 3. Load session & describe product
Looks up the stored photo for this chat. No photo yet: asks for one and stops. Otherwise downloads it and gets a factual product description.

## 4. Understand the offer
Voice note: download and transcribe with language + English translation. Text or caption: build the same fields directly.

## 5. Write & send brief
Gemini writes the marketing brief as JSON, it is parsed into fields, and the formatted brief is sent back to the shopkeeper.
